english.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a hollow cylindrical tube or pipe.
Use 管 as the general noun for a tubular passage in the body when the specific type is clear from context.

examples.jyutping: ni1 tiu4 gun2 lau6 seoi2 wo3

examples.english: The doctor said the pipe in my throat is a little inflamed.
examples.traditional: 醫生話我條氣管有啲發炎。
examples.jyutping: ji1 sang1 waa6 ngo5 tiu4 hei3 gun2 jau5 di1 faat3 jim4
